news.title: Embiid has season-high 37 and Brown adds 31 as 76ers beat Nets 135-123 without LeBron James
news.text: — Joel Embiid scored a season-high 37 points, Jaylen Brown matched his season best with 31 and the superstars provided the Philadelphia 76ers with more than enough in LeBron James' absence to beat the Brooklyn Nets 135-123 on Monday night.
